method.byteOrder: row-major RGBA, 4 bytes per pixel, read via getImageData(0, 0, width, height) from canvas.explorer__canvas after the computed stable frame is presented
method.scope: palette-inclusive proxy: the ring exposes no per-pixel period histogram, so the hash covers the final RGBA raster (status palette, period palette, smooth values) rather than discrete per-pixel fields
method.expectation: identical hashes expected on every case: the watched-lag triggered scan is bit-identical to the legacy scan on the corpus (Node parity); any mismatch is a finding
